user.title: Configure reQ Rekuperator
user.description: Configure MQTT in the device first. Enter a local IPv4 address to automatically read MAC. For older Wi-Fi firmware you may provide MAC manually.

data.name: Device name
data.host: Local device IPv4 (optional if MAC supplied)
data.mac: MAC address (optional when HTTP API is available)

error.invalid_host: Enter a private local IPv4 address
error.mac_mismatch: MAC does not match the local device
error.cannot_connect: Cannot read device API; enter MAC manually if Wi-Fi firmware is older
